I visited this restaurant expecting a premium dining experience, but unfortunately the guests at the neighbouring table were smoking, which made the environment uncomfortable. I was dining with my family and a little child, so this was particularly concerning.

I informed the manager, initially  he asked us to relocate our table and later advised the smokers to move away from the dining area, the situation ideally should not have occurred in the first place.

For a place positioned as a premium restaurant, proper enforcement of a strict non-smoking dining area is expected. I hope the management takes this seriously and improves the experience for future guests.

Restaurant is closed as per the location security

The worst place ever to have dinner. The waiters are not at all concerned on serving food .  Orders take mammoth time to be taken, and on top of that, numerous reminders that the order is pending to be delivered.

The most horrible thing that happened to us, was that the order was ready to be served, but just kept at the delivery counter, and no in the staff ordered to serve it on our table.

The most innovative way to spoil a weekend with cold food.

May be the chef needs to test his taste buds once to understand the taste of salt. We returned the chicken curry stating it’s too salty, but it looks like he stirred it again thinking the salt will go away, and returned. However the salt was the same but the pieces disappeared. When I asked the waiter he was also looking astonished and searching for it in the plate. We ordered rice and after almost 30 mins also it didn’t arrive. So we thought they have gone to the farmhouse to bring the grains to process and boil it. When the rice came at last, it looked like chef had just finished his dinner and the left over was brought to us, My puppy would have shouted at me for giving so less for Rs: 120/-. Anyway not that great experience. Ambiance is good, some of the items are good. But the delay is unbearable. Quantity is not up to the price either. It’s better we order and go for a movie and come back. If you are lucky enough your food will be ready.
